22.kr:
Pasywka wroga [138001] — tekst klimatyczny] 지령이 말한 대로 그때를 기다렸다고.
딸이 나가도 기다리고 기다렸지.

그러다 림버스 컴퍼니에서 연락이 왔고 뒷문이 열려있더구나.
그리고 단말기가 울려서 딸을 데리러 가야 할 때가 되었다는 것을 알았지.
22.en:
I waited for "the moment" as the Prescript told me to.
Even after my darling daughter left, I waited.

And after a while, I was contacted by Limbus Company, and saw that the Backdoor was open.
That's when the device beeped and let me know that it was finally time to bring my daughter home.

Each weapon has a unique effect. - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] When using an Attack Skill, gain 1 [StackRienSpecialSkill] (max 9) - Can be gained once per Skill; does not gain Stack from the same Skill twice Turn Start: At 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stacks, use a powerful Skill - Attack End: After using the powerful Skill for the first time, gain [Shin_Rien] - Reset the per-Skill [StackRienSpecialSkill] cap - Min & Max Speed +15 - Turn End: Gain 1 [Vulnerable] and 2 [ResultReduction] next turn Turn 3 Start: At less than 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], bring its Stack to 9; then, gain (Stack gained x 3) [KarmaOfIndexRien] - Then, activate this effect every 3 turns

25.kr: Pasywka wroga [138002] — tekst klimatyczny] 단말기 안에는 특이점과 유사한 기술을 이용해 형태와 질량을 변동시킬 수 있는, 금속 같은 액체가 들어 있다.\n이 액체는 단말기가 수령한 지령에 따라 모습을 바꾸며, 살해 대상의 정보와 주어진 제한 시간에 맞춰 무기로 변환된다.\n어느 날에는 지나치게 작은 단검이 배정되어 다른 무기로 바뀌기를 기다렸지만, 살해 제한 시간이 다가올 때까지 쓸만한 무기가 나오지 않았다. 결국, 마지막까지 기다려 나온 것이 포크였기에, 그 포크로 대상을 죽여야만 했다.
25.en: A vial of what looks like liquid metal capable of changing its shape and mass, its qualities almost like those of Singularities, swishes inside the Device.\nThe form the fluid takes is contingent on the Prescript the Device receives. The weapons it produces depend on the information regarding the target and the time limit given to carry out the assassination.\nOne day, as he received a dagger too small for the task, he elected to wait until it produced a different weapon. However, despite the approaching deadline, it refused to provide him a proper weapon; he had no choice but to kill his target with a fork.
